children: United States Natural Gas Fund reported that The Marygold Companies entered a definitive all-cash agreement with Madison Dearborn Partners to become a private company. Marygold is the sole shareholder of USCF Investments, the parent of United States Commodity Funds, the general partner of United States Natural Gas Fund. The deal is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to shareholder, regulatory, and change-of-control approvals, after which Marygold's stock will be delisted from the NYSE. Post-close, Madison Dearborn and Marygold leadership plan to execute Marygold's strategy to refocus USCF's business; there is no guarantee the transaction will close.
